title: einsum：迹、矩阵乘与全缩并
expected_output:
trace(A) = 12.0
matmul via einsum shape = (3, 2)
matches A@B = True
sum over all = 36.0
code:
import numpy as np
A = np.arange(9, dtype=np.float64).reshape(3, 3)
print("trace(A) =", np.einsum('ii->', A))
B = np.arange(6, dtype=np.float64).reshape(3, 2)
C = np.einsum('ij,jk->ik', A, B)
print("matmul via einsum shape =", C.shape)
print("matches A@B =", np.allclose(C, A @ B))
print("sum over all =", np.einsum('ij->', A))
